params.prompt: Recompose this square game key art into a wide 16:9 landscape cover banner for a game portfolio. Keep the exact same game logo lettering, spelling, colors and style, the same characters and the same art style, lighting and palette. Extend the scene naturally to the left and right so it fills the wide frame - no letterboxing, no borders, no extra text, no watermark. Place the logo clearly readable and fully inside the frame with comfortable margins, with the hero subject beside it. Scene: Nitro Nights - a neon night race circuit with floodlights, checkered flags and chevron barriers, the 'NITRO NIGHTS' orange-and-white badge logo with the red supercar leaping over it, a blue supercar drifting with smoke, flying gold coins and casino chips.
